kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: okonomiyaki, negiyaki and yakisoba (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, seafood, A5 beef and egg (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.hours_raw: Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–1:00 (last order 0:00); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Lunch set meals (February and October 2025). Tabelog says no cards, but an October 2025 diner paid by card and PayPay. 40 seats incl. a tatami room; whole-shop hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Takeaway (Tabelog). On Higashioji by the Chion-in bus stop, near Gion Kagetsu, 6 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog; September and December 2025).
kyoto_arachan_higashiyama.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashioji, to 1 am] A cheerful okonomiyaki and teppan house by Gion Kagetsu theatre, its walls covered in comedians’ autographs: fluffy okonomiyaki, negiyaki, yakisoba, A5 diced steak and tongue, with good-value lunch sets (buta-tama ¥1,150) and late hours. Smoking allowed; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: an okonomiyaki shop near the Gion Kagetsu theatre, popular with Yoshimoto comedians, now adding creative teppan dishes.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular brought a work party of 15 for the banquet course and noted it is a favourite of Yoshimoto comedians.
A December 2025 solo diner nearly skipped it as a regulars-only place, then came back and found it the best option nearby.
A February 2025 lunch guest had food on the table about five minutes after ordering.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き、東山区大和大路新橋東入ル林下町438、阪急河原町駅から徒歩10分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩6分、月・水〜日・祝日11:30〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:00)、火曜休み、カード不可 (2025年10月の口コミではカードと PayPay 可)、40席、座敷、喫煙可、テイクアウト、ふわふわのお好み焼き、A5 の角切りステーキ、京都の豆腐と Kujo ねぎの料理、常連に人気の卵焼き。口コミ (2022年10月〜2026年11月、英語): 祇園花月の近く、芸人のサインがいっぱい、昼の定食 (豚玉定食1,150円)、タンとリブロース、15名の宴会コース、ねぎ焼き、焼きそば、海鮮のお好み焼き、目玉焼きのせの豚ねぎ焼き。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk in for the lunch sets; book for groups. No English evidence found.

kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.gf_detail: Ask. Teppan wagyu courses with seasonal vegetables (2025–26 reviews); wagyu fillet katsu sandwiches are also sold (Tabelog); no gluten information.
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu teppan restaurant (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.hours_raw: Mon–Sat 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「無し」). Cards and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 6 (Tabelog). Bukkoji-dori east of Karasuma, 1 min from Shijo or Hankyu Karasuma (Tabelog). Opened 18 January 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_teppan_sosaku_rian.notes: [Wagyu teppan · Shijo-Karasuma, since 2019] A ten-seat teppan counter plus a private room just off Shijo-Karasuma, cooking Kuroge wagyu — Matsusaka strip loin, Chateaubriand, prize-winning Ushi no Nakayama fillet — in kaiseki-style courses with Kyoto vegetables and a 50-strong wine and sake list. Polished service; wagyu katsu sandwiches to order. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a teppanyaki restaurant opened in January 2019, serving Kyoto-cuisine-inspired meat dishes of selected Kuroge wagyu and seasonal Kyoto ingredients; a March 2025 diner notes staff from the Imperial Hotel.

anecdotes.text: A March 2025 diner, served by staff from the Imperial Hotel, was left speechless by the Chateaubriand.
A September 2026 diner found the salad of vegetables from across Kyoto and Japan a star in its own right before the fillet.
A July 2025 business guest called the course an ultimate meat kaiseki.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ・公式サイト: 鉄板焼き・日本料理・牛肉料理、下京区仏光寺通烏丸東入ル上柳町328、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅から徒歩1分、月〜土17:30〜22:00、日曜休み、サービス料なし、カード・PayPay 可、16席 (カウンター10、個室6)、2019年1月18日オープン、厳選した黒毛和牛と京都の旬の食材の京料理風の肉料理、おまかせコース (松阪牛ストリップロイン100g 28,600円、シャトーブリアン100g)、ワインと日本酒50種以上、黒毛和牛ヒレのカツサンド (予約制)。口コミ (2019年9月〜2026年9月、英語): 帝国ホテル出身のスタッフ、シャトーブリアン、肉の会席、綾部・城陽・大原の野菜と加賀れんこんのサラダ、Ushi no Nakayama の黒毛和牛ヒレ100g。

cultural_comfort.note: Reserve a course; private room for six. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing and official site; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.gf_detail: Ask. A wine and sake shop with a tasting counter; drinks only in the sources (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.vegan_detail: Ask. Natural wines, sake and craft beer at the counter (2025–26 reviews); no vegan information.
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–21:00; may change (Tabelog). Cards (Tabelog). A 6-seat counter (Tabelog). Bottles of over ¥3,000 from the shelves can be opened at the counter with no corkage (November 2025). Yaoichi Honkan 2F, Higashinotoin south of Sanjo (Tabelog).
kyoto_maeda_toyosaburo_shoten.notes: [Wine and sake counter · Higashinotoin-Sanjo] A liquor shop on the second floor of Yaoichi Honkan with a six-seat counter where you can drink natural wine, local sake or craft beer by the glass from 10:00 to 21:00 — or open a bottle from the shelves (over ¥3,000) with no corkage. A handy stop while shopping.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviews: a wine and sake shop inside Yaoichi Honkan with a tasting counter.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 regular opened a Champagne bought in the shop at the counter, free of corkage over ¥3,000.
A February 2026 visitor found warmth there on a snowy Kyoto night.
A September 2026 shopper had a glass of orange wine while waiting for the day’s deli dish.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ワインバー、中京区東洞院三条下る三文字町220 八百一本館 2F、毎日10:00〜21:00、カード可、6席。口コミ (2014年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 自然派ワイン、地酒、クラフトビールをカウンターで、3,000円以上のボトルは持ち込み料なし、昼に一杯とワインの購入、百貨店の地下のようなカウンター、オレンジワイン。

cultural_comfort.note: Order a glass at the counter or pick a bottle from the shelves.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_sushi_ryuka.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi on red-vinegar rice with soy and cooked side dishes; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi omakase (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Thursday–Sunday 18:00–22:30, two seatings at 18:00 and 20:30; closed Wednesday, though a Wednesday may be arranged in advance (Tabelog). Reservations through TableCheck ("Kyoto Sushi Ryuka - 鮨 流嘉"); seat requests may change (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), e-money and QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: 7 at the counter and a private room with a table for 4 (Tabelog). Gokomachi above Oike, a short walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; September 2025). Opened in summer 2025 (June–August 2025 reviews).
kyoto_sushi_ryuka.notes: [Sushi · Gokomachi-Oike, 11 seats] A new, glossy sushi counter near City Hall serving a ¥20,000 omakase of thick-cut fish on red-vinegar rice, with seasonal rarities and showy pieces topped with caviar and truffle. Two seatings nightly; book on TableCheck. Some 2026 guests found the service and pairings unpolished.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a sushi counter that opened in summer 2025 near Kyoto City Hall, with a modern, gold-accented interior and an entertaining chef (July 2025–February 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic sushi for everyday Kyoto, easy for first-timers (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A July 2025 diner discovered unfamiliar seasonal fish such as aburabozu and called the wild tuna the best ever eaten.
A February 2026 guest liked the fish but found the pieces piled with smoked meat, caviar and truffle too much luxury on luxury.
A January 2026 visitor praised the sushi but found the service let down by a new part-time staff member.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 寿司、中京区御幸町通御池上る亀屋町384、市役所前駅のすぐ近く、月・火・木〜日 18:00〜22:30、2部制 (18:00・20:30)、水曜休み (事前相談で可)、予約は TableCheck「Kyoto Sushi Ryuka - 鮨 流嘉」から、カード (VISA・Master・JCB・AMEX・Diners・銀聯)・電子マネー・QR 可、11席 (カウンター7、4名の個室1)。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 2025年夏の開店、赤酢のシャリ、厚く贅沢なネタ、天然のまぐろ、あぶらぼうずなど珍しい季節の魚、おまかせ流嘉コース20,000円 (税込)、燻製の肉・キャビア・トリュフをのせた握り、金を使った内装、楽しい料理人、新しいアルバイトの接客が不慣れだったとの声 (2026年1月)、組み合わせがいまひとつとの声 (2026年3月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on TableCheck; two seatings; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.gf_detail: Ask. Raw-fish bowls may suit, but the marinated salmon and tuna sauces, soy and sauce katsu are not wheat-free; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.vegan_detail: Not vegan: seafood bowls, sauce katsu and pork miso soup (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30), closing early when sold out (Tabelog). Reservations through Tabelog only, not by phone; a seat-only booking costs ¥200 unless you order a drink (Tabelog original 席だけ予約の場合のみ200円). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). 27 seats: 7 at the counter and tables for 2 and 4 (Tabelog). Take-away available (Tabelog). Daihachi Hase building B1F on Karasuma below Bukkoji; a few minutes from Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_kaisen_tokidoki_buta.notes: [Seafood bowls · Karasuma-Bukkoji, basement, cash only] A casual basement bowl shop near Shijo-Karasuma where you build a kaisen-don from some 28 toppings — tuna, marinated salmon, negitoro, ikura — from ¥900, or try the Fukui sauce katsu; a cheap weekday set until 2 p.m. Solo-friendly. Some found the fish ordinary for the price.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a seafood-bowl and set-meal shop in a basement near Shijo-Karasuma offering customisable bowls of seasonal fish, bluefin tuna and salmon, and Fukui-style sauce katsu, with friendly staff (2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 salmon lover booked the social-media-only bowl, ¥2,200 and five a day, and piled on marinated salmon until saying stop.
A March 2026 diner arriving just before closing was kindly served a cheap and delicious toro-taku bowl.
An April 2026 visitor found the tuna fishy and the bowl no better than a chain's.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 海鮮丼・食堂・海鮮、下京区烏丸通仏光寺下ル大政所町680-1 第八長谷ビル B1F、毎日 11:00〜21:00 (L.O.20:30)、売り切れ次第終了、予約は食べログのみで電話不可、席だけの予約は200円 (ドリンク注文で不要)、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、27席 (カウンター7、テーブル)、テイクアウト可、約28種から選ぶ海鮮丼900円から、本まぐろ、鮭、福井のソースかつ、鯛のあら汁、豚汁。口コミ (2026年1月〜8月、英語): 平日14時までのサービス丼980円、SNS 限定・予約制で1日5食の漬けサーモンのせ放題2,200円、ねぎとろ・とろたく、鯛、海老、しらす、いくらや卵黄の追加、まぐろ・いか・アボカド・海苔の韓国風の丼、一人でも入りやすい、値段のわりに普通・まぐろが生臭いとの声 (2026年1・4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; book via Tabelog only; solo-friendly.

kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.gf_detail: Not GF: fried dishes and soy-based simmered fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood and chicken izakaya (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.hours_raw: Monday–Saturday 18:00–3:00 (last orders food 2:00, drinks 2:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; banquet courses (Tabelog). The appetiser is grilled at the table on a small charcoal grill and was thought pricey (September 2024; August 2026). Cards; no e-money (Tabelog). 70 seats with a counter and a sunken-kotatsu room for 14 (Tabelog). Non-smoking since April 2020 (Tabelog). No phone signal in the basement (November 2024). Sanjo COHJU building B1F, Sanjo east of Karasuma, near the Museum of Kyoto (Tabelog).
kyoto_ryoma_sanjo_karasuma.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Sanjo-Karasuma basement, till 3 a.m.] A big, busy basement izakaya open until 3 a.m., with fish from around Japan, charcoal-grilled chicken and an appetiser you grill yourself on a shichirin. Popular with students and office workers; non-smoking. The appetiser charge is on the high side. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a 70-seat seafood izakaya near Sanjo-Karasuma open until 3 a.m. with seasonal seafood delivered daily and banquet courses (2024–2026 reviews).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 diner found fish here that are rarely seen in Kyoto, at fair prices.
A November 2025 group, finding the Oike bars closing early, came here for a second round and grilled the appetiser on the shichirin.
An August 2026 regular enjoyed the charcoal-grilled black chicken but felt the once-rare sashimi had become ordinary.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・鍋、中京区三条通烏丸東入ル梅忠町24 三条COHJUビル B1F、京都文化博物館の近く、月〜土 18:00〜翌3:00 (L.O.料理2:00、飲み物2:30)、日曜休み、予約可、宴会コース、カード可、電子マネー不可、70席、14名の掘りごたつの個室、2020年4月から店内禁煙。口コミ (2024年6月〜2026年9月、英語): 七輪で焼く先付 (とびうおのひれ、いわし、海老など)、京都では珍しい魚の刺身、あぶらぼうずの煮付け、黒鶏の炭火焼き、焼き物、鍋、メニューが豊富、学生から会社員まで、お通しがやや高いとの声、地下で電波がない (2024年11月)、刺身が普通になったとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Late night; non-smoking; appetiser charged; cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.gf_detail: Ask. Mizutaki chicken broth may suit, but it is served with ponzu, and kaiseki and sukiyaki use soy; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: chicken mizutaki, beef and fish (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.hours_raw: Daily 11:00–22:00 (last orders food 20:30, drinks 21:00); closing days irregular (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No charge for appetisers (Tabelog original お通し代なし). Cash only — no cards, e-money or QR; ask about payment for banquets (Tabelog). 200 tatami seats; private rooms for 2 to over 30 (Tabelog). A designated smoking area (Tabelog). In the north woods of Maruyama Park, next to Yasaka Shrine; about 15 min by car from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_torikyu_maruyama.notes: [Mizutaki and kaiseki · Maruyama Park] A ryokan-like house in Maruyama Park, said to date from 1896, serving Nagoya Cochin chicken mizutaki in private tatami rooms — rich broth, homemade ponzu, porridge to finish — plus yudofu and seasonal Kyoto gozen. Kind, attentive staff. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a renowned restaurant of over 100 years in Maruyama Park, serving seasonal Kyoto kaiseki and hot pots such as mizutaki. A November 2024 reviewer gives its founding as 1896.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto kaiseki and traditional hot pots (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A March 2024 former university club member came back for a farewell party, as the club always had, and the staff kept out of the room during speeches.
A May 2024 visitor's mother felt cold and the staff promptly brought a lap blanket.
An October 2026 birthday party had the Wakadori mizutaki at ¥6,600 and a complimentary agedashi tofu.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 日本料理・鍋、東山区円山公園北林、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O.料理20:30、飲み物21:00)、不定休、予約可、お通し代なし、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、宴会の支払いは相談、200席 (座敷)、個室 (2名〜30名以上)、分煙、創業100年以上の老舗、円山公園で季節の京懐石と水炊きなどの鍋。口コミ (2024年2月〜2026年10月、英語): 八坂神社の隣、旅館のような雰囲気、名古屋コーチンの水炊きと自家製ポン酢、締めのおかゆ、若鶏の水炊き6,600円 (2026年10月)、1896年創業との声 (2024年11月)、Yasaka 御膳 (おぼろ豆腐、鱧、赤だし)、湯豆腐の会席、和牛ステーキの御膳、夏のすき焼き、ていねいな接客。

cultural_comfort.note: Cash only; private tatami rooms; book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: the food is toast, sandwiches, pancakes and cake; drinks only (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.vegan_detail: Ask. Coffee, tea, juices, sodas and shaved ice; the food uses egg, cheese and butter (reviews).
kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.hours_raw: 09:00–18:00; closed Tuesday (Gion shopping street association; Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). No cards or e-money; QR payments accepted (Tabelog). 38 seats, tables only; non-smoking; Wi-Fi (Tabelog; June 2026). At the south-west corner of Shijo and Hanamikoji, across from Ichiriki Chaya (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_kissa_noen_gion.notes: [Kissaten · Shijo–Hanamikoji corner, a retro café since early Showa] An old-fashioned coffee shop on a busy Gion corner, calm inside, with breakfast sets from ¥650, a ¥1,000 hot egg sandwich set, thick honey-cheese toast and shaved ice in summer. No cards — QR pay accepted; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in the early Showa era as a Western-style restaurant, then rare; now a coffee shop serving coffee and light meals, still aiming "to serve what customers find delicious" (Gion shopping street association). Reviewers (2014–2026) describe a nostalgic café with kind staff, local regulars reading newspapers and many overseas visitors.
chef_bio.philosophy: To serve what customers find delicious, as since the founding (Gion shopping street association).

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 regular had the ¥650 morning set before a kabuki show at the Minamiza.
An October 2026 regular praised the hot egg sandwich set for not having raised the price.
A July 2026 Saturday visitor escaped the heat with a ¥780 Blue Hawaii shaved ice.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 祇園商店街振興組合: 喫茶 農園、京都市東山区祇園町南側571、当時は珍しい西洋料理のレストランとして昭和初期に開業、現在はこだわりのコーヒーと軽食の喫茶店、「お客様に美味しいと思っていただけるものをお出ししたい」という想いは創業当時から、9:00〜18:00、火曜定休。食べログ: NOEN、カフェ・喫茶店、四条花見小路西南角、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR決済可、38席 (テーブルのみ)、禁煙。口コミ (2014〜2026年、英語): 南座の観劇前に、モーニングBセット (トースト、サラダ、コーヒー) 650円、コーヒー550円、ホットエッグサンドのサラダとドリンク付き1,000円、ベーコンエッグトーストのセット、チーズとはちみつの厚切りトースト、パンケーキ、ケーキ、メロンソーダ、レモンスカッシュ、バナナジュース、ブルーハワイのかき氷780円、レトロで落ち着いた店内、新聞を読む地元客、海外の客も多い、Wi-Fi、一力亭の向かい。

cultural_comfort.note: Walk-in café, many overseas guests; no cards, QR pay accepted.

kyoto_gion_eguchi.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki with dashi, soy and saikyo miso, suppon and fugu hot pots, sushi to finish; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_gion_eguchi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki built on fish, suppon and dashi (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_eguchi.hours_raw: 17:30–23:00 (last order 22:00); closed Sunday (official site). Tabelog gives 17:30–22:00 Monday–Saturday and holidays, last order 21:00 and last seating 19:30. Reservations taken, also online; cancellation 100% up to 3 days before, 50% 4–7 days before; at least one drink per person (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money (Tabelog). Service charge 6% (Tabelog). 30 seats: a counter, tatami rooms and private rooms for 8 and 10–20; non-smoking except in the private rooms; children welcome (Tabelog; official site). Katsumi Building 1F on Kiyomoto-cho, also reached from the Kiritoshi side (Tabelog).
kyoto_gion_eguchi.notes: [Kaiseki · Gion Kiyomoto-cho, suppon all year] A calm Gion kaiseki house whose owner trained at Kyoto Kitcho: seasonal courses from ¥8,500 with a flower-dressed opening plate, plus suppon, hamo shabu-shabu and torafugu courses. Counter and private tatami rooms; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: The owner trained at Kyoto Kitcho and was head chef at two other restaurants before opening Gion Eguchi (September 2025 review). The official site, signed by owner 小林宏哉, describes choosing tableware and settings, wild hamo bought by the owner, suppon all year and menus that change with the seasons.
chef_bio.philosophy: Thoughtful hospitality: tableware chosen to suit, settings arranged with care, seasonal ingredients at the peak, each plate beautiful and easy to eat (official site).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 guest returned after six years to the owner’s attentive service.
An April 2026 last-minute diner watched the head chef run the counter alone at an impressive pace.
A July 2026 business dinner had hamo twice, in a vinegared dish and a soup.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 祇おん 江口、京都市東山区清本町369 かつみビル1F、17:30〜23:00 (L.O.22時)、日曜定休、店主 小林宏哉、心を尽くすおもてなし、器の取り合わせとしつらい、旬の素材、すっぽん料理を通年で、鱧など天然物を店主が厳選、季節で変わる献立、カウンター席と完全個室、座敷、接待や宴会。食べログ: ぎおん えぐち、日本料理・ふぐ・すっぽん、月〜土・祝日 17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:00、最終入店19:30)、日曜定休、カード可、PayPay可、電子マネー不可、サービス料6%、30席、個室 (8名、10〜20名)、個室のみ喫煙可、子供可、1人1ドリンク以上、キャンセル料は3日前から100%・4〜7日前は50%、コース: おまかせ8品8,500円、9品9,500円、焼酎の飲み放題90分付き9品13,000円、すっぽんコース10,800円、鱧しゃぶコース10,800円、とらふぐのコース (てっさ、てっちり、雑炊) 10,800円。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): 京都吉兆で修業し2店で料理長を務めた店主、花を添えた先付、鱧、鶏の西京焼き、鮎の焼き物、赤だし、巻き寿司と押し寿司、ひとりで切り盛りする日も、落ち着いた雰囲気、値段は祇園では手ごろ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; cancellation fees from 7 days; 6% service.

kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.gf_detail: Ask. Oden and obanzai in dashi and soy, kamameshi; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: oden and obanzai in dashi; the kamameshi seen in reviews had bacon (October 2025).
kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.hours_raw: 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:30 daily, then 21:30–00:30 as a karaoke bar; closing days vary (Tabelog; October 2025). Lunch: one set per diner — kamadaki oden set ¥1,980, Okoshiyasu lunch ¥1,650, obanzai and kamameshi lunch ¥2,420 (November 2025); kamameshi takes about 30 minutes (March 2026). Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted (Tabelog). A 13-seat counter; non-smoking; Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Hanami Kaikan 1F, Tominaga-cho, near Hanamikoji (Tabelog; March 2026).
kyoto_okoshiyasu_oden_gion.notes: [Oden & obanzai · Gion Tominaga-cho, lunch sets and late karaoke] A thirteen-seat counter lined with Kyoto obanzai, with oden and kamameshi cooked to order: lunch sets from ¥1,650, oden in the evening, and karaoke with the mama-san from 9:30 pm.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers (2022–2026) describe a small counter where the owner chats with guests over oden and obanzai; one person can run lunch alone (November 2025), and from 21:30 the mama-san turns the place into a karaoke bar (October 2025).

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 guest who left a hat behind had it posted home with a note and a maiko postcard.
An October 2025 party of four older guests had sweet-potato-and-bacon kamameshi cooked at the counter.
An October 2025 late wanderer arrived at 9:30 pm just as the sign changed to karaoke.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: おこしやす おでんとおばんざい、ちょっと釜めし、居酒屋・おでん、京都市東山区富永町123 花見会館1F、毎日 12:00〜15:00、18:00〜21:30、21:30〜0:30、定休日は不定、予約可、カード・電子マネー・QR決済可 (PayPay、Alipay、WeChat Pay)、13席、禁煙、Wi-Fi、1人でも入りやすい。口コミ (2022〜2026年、英語): おでんとおばんざい、目の前で炊く釜めし、さつまいもとベーコンの釜めし (2025年10月)、ランチは1人1セット、釜炊きおでんのセット1,980円、おこしやすランチ1,650円、おばんざいと釜めしのランチ2,420円 (2025年11月)、釜めしは30分ほどかかる、ランチはひとりで切り盛り、21時半からはママのカラオケ、忘れた帽子を舞妓のはがきを添えて送ってくれた、修学旅行生の割引、おばんざいに覆いがないのが気になるという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Small counter; one lunch set per diner; karaoke after 21:30.

kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.gf_detail: Ask. Creative izakaya dishes with dashi; katsu sandwiches, gyoza and gratin are on the menu; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, meat and dashi-based dishes (reviews).
kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00; closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). 34 seats: counter, tables, a tatami private room for 6–8 and a private room for 8–12 (no children) upstairs; non-smoking (Tabelog). A renovated townhouse in Miyagawa-cho, east of Matsubara and Kawabata (Tabelog; March 2026). Opened 13 July 2018; sister shop of Apollo+ in the Apollo Group (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_apollo_shokudo_miyagawacho.notes: [Izakaya · Miyagawa-cho, creative dishes in a townhouse] A calm, renovated townhouse in the Miyagawa-cho geisha quarter serving inventive izakaya food — thick sashimi, ginger gyoza, a well-liked wagyu katsu sandwich — with fresh-fruit sours and a long wine list. Courses with free drinks from ¥6,600; book ahead; closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Opened in July 2018 as part of the Apollo Group, whose other open shop is Apollo+ near Sanjo (Tabelog). Reviewers (2025–2026) describe a calm Miyagawa-cho townhouse with attentive service and many overseas guests.
chef_bio.specialty: Creative izakaya dishes; wagyu katsu sandwich.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner singled out the rock-oyster gratin and wagyu katsu sandwich on the ¥8,800 course.
A July 2026 guest took the beef katsu sandwich home for breakfast.
An August 2026 regular had lost count of visits and finds booking essential.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京Apollo食堂 (京アポロ食堂)、ダイニングバー・居酒屋・海鮮、京都市東山区新宮川町通松原下ル西御門町444、月・水〜日 17:00〜24:00、火曜定休、カード・電子マネー・PayPay可、34席、個室 (2階に6〜8名の座敷、8〜12名の個室は子供不可)、禁煙、2018年7月13日オープン、アポログループ (アポロプラス)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 宮川町の町家を改装、飲み放題付きコース6,600円、8,800円のコースで焼き茄子のポタージュ、岩牡蠣のグラタン、和牛のカツサンド、刺身の盛り合わせ、鶏レバーの生姜煮、生姜餃子、揚げ茄子、椎茸の肉詰め、持ち帰りの牛カツサンド、フルーツたっぷりのサワーと自家製果実酒、ワインが充実、海外の客も多い、予約は必須、料理の間が空くという声、家庭的な味という声も。

Counter seats only (2025–26 reviews). Down a very narrow alley in Gion north of Shijo, 4–5 min from Yasaka Shrine (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_rokuroku_tantan_gion.notes: [Tantanmen · Gion] A small counter down a narrow Gion alley serving one thing: a creamy, mildly spicy golden-sesame tantanmen, finished with rice and cheese as a risotto. About ¥1,200.

chef_bio.background: Opened 30 June 2024 (Tabelog). The soup uses roasted Japanese golden sesame and sesame paste over a broth of Hokkaido kombu, shiitake and chicken (October 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 diner heard the shop is popular with Yoshimoto comedians, was told to try the balsamic vinegar on the counter, and was amazed how well it worked.
A June 2026 visitor, nervous about the narrow alley, was lent a paper apron by the master.
A January 2025 diner paid ¥1,700 for the coriander bowl and later learned prices were raised ¥500 over the first three days of the New Year.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ロクロクタンタン、tantanmen、東山区祇園町北側286-6、祇園四条駅から447m、月〜金 11:30〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、土 12:00〜14:30・17:00〜20:30、日曜休み、2024年6月30日オープン。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 4種類、ロクロクタンタン1,000円 (2025年)・1,200円 (2026年9月)、パクチーのせ1,400円 (2025年10月)、金ごまと練りごま、Hokkaido の昆布・しいたけ・鶏のスープ、京都の老舗の製麺所の麺、最後にご飯とチーズでリゾット風、カウンターのみ、狭い路地、現金・カード可。

kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and sashimi may suit, but fried dishes and sauces are common (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal vegetable obanzai (February 2024), but dashi is likely; the owner adjusts dishes for guests (2024–25 reviews).
kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.hours_raw: Tue–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Mondays (Tabelog). Tax and 10% service charge (Tabelog, whose "Original text" is in English: "Tax and Service charge 10% will be charged when checking."). Cards and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 14 seats: 6 at the counter and 6–8 at tables; non-smoking; no children (Tabelog). English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog). 8 min from Gion-Shijo (Tabelog).
kyoto_osake_to_oryori_kiharu.notes: [Obanzai · Gion] A cosy wood-lined counter where the owner cooks seasonal obanzai and pairs sake and wine, with an English menu and many overseas regulars. About ¥5,000–8,000 plus 10%; adults only.

chef_bio.background: Opened 24 September 2023 (Tabelog). The owner once worked at a famous obanzai izakaya in Gion and runs the place with a part-timer (February 2024 review); trained properly in cooking (September 2024 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal Kyoto vegetables, seafood and wagyu with sake from around Japan and wines (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai platter; shrimp and lotus-root dumplings.

anecdotes.text: A February 2024 solo diner on a business trip had portions sized down, booked again for Thursday, and was remembered and served the dishes mentioned on the first night.
A September 2024 guest, brought by the mama of a usual Gion bar, was served an off-menu sea bream simmered in sake.
A March 2024 regular notes that drinks not on the menu are sourced from various suppliers to match the dishes.

cultural_comfort.note: English menu and English-speaking staff (Tabelog); many overseas guests (2024–25 reviews).

kyoto_menya_taro_sanjo.hours_raw: Daily 8:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); closing days may vary (Tabelog). 2024–25 reviews mention opening at 7:00. Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 18 seats: a counter downstairs and tables upstairs (Tabelog; March 2025 review); non-smoking (Tabelog). In the Sanjo Shokusai Roji alley off Sakaimachi, 5 min from Karasuma-Oike, Shijo or Karasuma (Tabelog).
kyoto_menya_taro_sanjo.notes: [Somen · Sanjo] A somen specialist in a Sanjo food alley, open from 8 am, serving the warm, slightly sweet somen of the owner's Hokkaido home with seasoned rice and shaved ice. About ¥1,300–1,700; the owner speaks English.

chef_bio.background: Opened 3 June 2024 (Tabelog). The owner recreates the flavours of a family home in Hokkaido (September 2024 review) and used to work as a restaurant consultant (November 2025 review); English picked up from customers (June 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: Somen eaten warm, the Hokkaido way — "a different flavour of nyumen from Kansai and Kanto" (shop sign, March 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A January 2025 regular finally got the Hokkaido-style somen, which on an earlier visit was off because the owner was not happy with the taste that day.
A March 2025 couple followed the smell of dashi into the alley and found the downstairs counter full of Western tourists.
A September 2024 diner who skipped the shaved ice was given some anyway, and found it the best thing there.

kyoto_soda_shoten_kissa.notes: [Kissa · Shimogyo] A five-seat counter kissa where the owner, working alone, brews each coffee to order and makes thick toast breakfasts and a fluffy tamagoyaki baguette. Under ¥1,000.

chef_bio.background: The owner runs the shop alone (February 2025 and February 2026 reviews). Opened as a place for locals to gather over coffee (October 2025 review).
chef_bio.philosophy: A place where locals can gather and enjoy coffee at leisure (October 2025 review).

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 couple let a takeaway customer go first, and got a free coffee refill from the owner in thanks.
A February 2026 guest asked for a café au lait and was given warm milk at no charge.
A May 2026 visitor called the tamagoyaki in the baguette the best omelette ever eaten, as several groups were turned away.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 左右田商店喫茶室、喫茶店、下京区忠庵町307-1、清水五条駅から490m、水〜土 8:30〜16:00、月・火・日曜休み、カード・電子マネー・PayPay 可、カウンター5席、禁煙。口コミ (2024〜2026年、英語): 店主が一人で営む、Toast A 500円、Toast B 700円、卵焼きのバゲットサンド550円、8:00〜11:00は飲み物が200円、ブレンドコーヒー450円 (マイルドとビター)、Beans Tei の豆、固めのプリン、テイクアウト可。

Repeat reviewers praise attentive but unobtrusive service and careful handling of dietary restrictions, including half portions (June–October 2026). kyoto_kuradai_hassai.notes: [Fermentation cuisine · Karasuma-Oike, a miso maker's townhouse dining room] A new restaurant from the miso shop 蔵代味噌 where every course runs on fermentation — house miso soups, koji-cured fish, Hatcho-miso wagyu, clay-pot rice — at about ¥4,000 for lunch and ¥10,000+ at dinner. Reservation only; tell them of allergies ahead. Closed Sunday and Monday.

roles: Operator: the miso wholesaler behind 蔵代味噌

An April 2026 reviewer writes that it is a fermentation restaurant run by a long-established miso wholesaler, "Japanix" (romaji as given), and a September 2026 reviewer links it to Kuradai Miso, the bulk miso shop near Nishiki Market. A June 2026 reviewer says one person cooks. Criticism: pricey for the portion and water only on request (October 2026); a limited lunch menu (June 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Fermentation knowledge — koji, miso, amazake — to nourish body and mind (April 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Fermentation courses; house miso soups; clay-pot rice.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "This is a fermentation cuisine restaurant run by a long-established miso wholesaler… The variety of fermented ingredients is impressive, including the unique fermented udo!"

September 2026: "I used to visit Kuradai Miso, a bulk miso shop near Nishiki Market, whenever I went to Kyoto… When I heard that Kuradai Hassai opened as a restaurant in February 2026, I decided to visit."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 蔵代醗彩、日本料理・創作料理、中京区亀甲屋町608-1、烏丸御池駅から徒歩5分、火〜土・祝日・祝日の前日と翌日12:00〜14:30 (料理L.O.13:30)・17:30〜22:00 (料理L.O.21:00)、日・月曜休み (三連休明けは火曜も)、完全予約制、アレルギーは事前に連絡を (当日は対応できない場合あり)、カード・交通系IC・電子マネー可、18席、個室 (4・6名、2,000円)、禁煙、スマートカジュアル、子供は大人と同じ料理が食べられる小学生以上、英語・中国語・韓国語メニュー、2026年2月25日オープン。口コミ (2026年3月〜10月、英語): 蔵代味噌の発酵料理店、町家を改装、発酵松花堂4,180円 (土鍋ご飯と2種の味噌汁、2026年4月)、4種の味噌の味噌汁、発酵うど、発酵白菜のパテ、酒粕の鯖、Hatcho味噌ソースの和牛、白味噌汁、Tangoの貝の酢味噌、生麩田楽、Tanba鶏の味噌唐揚げ、銀だらの西京焼き、しそ味噌のおにぎり、さつまいものアイス (2026年9月)、料理人は一人 (2026年6月)、量の割に高め・水は頼まないと出ないとの声 (2026年10月)。

kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.vegan_detail: Ask: Tabelog marks vegetarian options and the shop is particular about vegetables; pumpkin and spinach daily curries, chana masala, vegetable biryani and dal bhat appear in reviews (2018–2026), but ghee, cream and yogurt sauces were not described.
kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00; closed on irregular days. Reservations taken. Cards. 46 seats; private hire for parties of 20–35. Non-smoking. Take-out. Kids' menu (Tabelog). Coin-parking cash-back ¥100 at lunch, ¥200 at dinner (Tabelog). 1 min south of the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing, past Yasaka-dori; 2 min from the Higashiyama-Yasui bus stop. kyoto_namaste_dhaulagiri_yasui.notes: [Indian & Nepali · Higashiyama-Yasui near Yasaka Shrine, a curry house for sightseers] A roomy curry house a minute from the Higashiyama-Yasui crossing, with good-value lunch sets from ¥850, Nepali dal bhat and momo, biryani and cheese naan, and an all-you-can-eat-and-drink option. Vegetarian choices. Open daily 11:00–22:00.

chef_bio.background: Opened 27 December 2015 (Tabelog). Reviewers describe a friendly manager (2017), the smell of incense, North Indian curries and Nepali dishes, and many overseas guests (2024). Criticism: a salty chicken curry and soup in a children's plastic cup (January 2020); mild, similar curries in the special lunch and a cramped toilet (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch curry sets; momo; dal bhat.

anecdotes.text: November 2022: "This chicken momo appears in the form of dumplings floating in a tangy broth… Moreover… they were delicious!"
September 2025: "This was my first experience with biryani, and it came with a yogurt-based sauce for a flavor twist. It was delicious and not spicy at all."

kyoto_hunto_standing_bar.notes: [Standing bar & take-out · Shimogawara near Yasaka Shrine, wagyu dogs and fruit sodas] A sleek concrete standing bar on Shimogawara-dori serving charcoal-grilled wagyu skewers, wagyu hot dogs, berry "fruit dogs" and bright fruit sodas or sours, from late morning, to eat in or carry along the sightseeing route. Most items ¥500–1,350. Open daily.

kyoto_bistro_le_saint_jou.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pâté, ayu, carpaccio, beef stew and cheesecake (2025 reviews).

kyoto_bistro_le_saint_jou.notes: [Bistro · Gojo-Takakura, a one-man counter] A tiny counter bistro where the friendly owner cooks everything alone in a spotless open kitchen: half portions of pâté, grilled ayu, pasta and beef stew, or a course with bread baked fresh between dishes. Book by phone.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers say the owner runs the bistro single-handed (April and October 2025), describe a friendly, cheerful chef (May and September 2025) and an open kitchen kept spotless (May 2026).

anecdotes.text: A May 2025 regular found the chef disappointed not to have the Toyama fish for the carpaccio that day — and still loved it.
At an October 2025 birthday dinner the party were the only guests, and the homemade bread proved impossible to stop eating.

kyoto_hana_koma_okonomiyaki.notes: [Okonomiyaki · Higashiyama near Kodai-ji, owner-run] A homely, Showa-feeling okonomiyaki house in the quiet lanes between Kodai-ji and Kiyomizu, run by a cheerful owner alone — mixed okonomiyaki from ¥800, buta-tama and yakisoba at prices free of tourist mark-ups. chef_bio.background: An April 2026 reviewer writes that a cheerful owner runs the place alone, giving it a homely feel.

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 visitor, hungry after a long day of walking near Kiyomizu, stopped for a ¥800 mixed okonomiyaki with extra green onion.

kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.gf_detail: Ask. Kyoto kaiseki courses with hot pots, seasonal fish, Wagyu and Kyoto vegetables; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: kaiseki of fish, black Wagyu and hot pots in dashi (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday–Saturday and days before holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; Sunday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday, though it may open on request (Tabelog). Down a long corridor from an alley off Kiyamachi by the Takase river, north of Oike, 3 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae (Tabelog; 2025 reviews).
kyoto_onjaku_sakontaro_honten.notes: [Kyoto kaiseki · Kamikiyamachi, a former ryokan] A calm kaiseki house reached down a long corridor off Kiyamachi, in a century-old former ryokan by the Takase river, with private rooms for 2 to 30: seasonal fish, black Wagyu and Kyoto vegetables in courses of about ¥8,000–11,000, and sake plans for groups. Closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Flagged: tied to the たん熊北店 group per a review.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T8130001026429 is registered to 株式会社左近太郎 of Sakyo-ku (NTA register). A January 2026 reviewer says the restaurant belongs to the same group as 熊魚菴 たん熊北店. Reviewers praise well-timed, polite service (July 2025, August 2026).

Smoking allowed (Tabelog). Take-away (Tabelog). Kiyomizu 5-chome near Rokuharamitsuji and Rokudo Chinnoji (2026 reviews).
kyoto_chikara_mochi_shokudo_kiyomizu5.notes: [Udon and mochi diner · near Rokuharamitsuji, cash only] A homely 力餅食堂 near Rokuharamitsuji serving gentle-dashi udon — chikara udon with grilled mochi, kitsune, curry, beef-tendon ankake — with red rice, inari and kinako ohagi. Popular at lunch; share a table. Smoking allowed. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per reviewers: one of the Kyoto diners carrying the 力餅食堂 name, near Rokuharamitsuji and Rokudo Chinnoji, with young staff alongside the old hands (January 2026), loved locally and busy with visitors (2026 reviews). Drafted on its own evidence under Greg's ruling that noren-wake families such as 力餅食堂 are not chains.

anecdotes.text: A January 2026 visitor on a twelfth Chikara Mochi visit was glad to see young staff carrying the shop on, and praised the beef-tendon ankake udon.
An April 2026 diner came casually for curry udon and rated it among the best udon in Kyoto, along with the red rice.
An October 2026 regular on the way to Rokuharamitsuji got the last inari-zushi to go with a chikara udon.

kyoto_ristorante_strada.notes: [Italian · Oike-Yanaginobamba] A long-standing Italian behind a stone facade near City Hall: a good-value ¥4,400 lunch course of lavish antipasti, handmade pasta and crisp-skinned amadai, and richer dinners with wine pairings; private rooms with a storybook feel. 10% service at dinner. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian restaurant opened 1 April 2005 at the corner of Oike and Yanaginobamba. Reviewers in 2026 describe a stone exterior, a calm interior with private rooms and regulars who return for anniversaries.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 couple, back again for a wedding anniversary, started with horse meat and the assorted antipasti the couple always loves.
A June 2026 group booked a private room for the lunch course and felt like walking into Harry Potter.
A May 2026 lunch guest in heavy rain watched the room fill up, and singled out the crisp-skinned sautéed amadai.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: an Edomae sushi counter opened 1 July 2022 near Kyoto City Hall, known for aged fish and a friendly, approachable chef (2023–2025 reviews).

A November 2025 guest found the chef approachable, unlike stiff traditional sushi bars, and the experience worth the price.

Book the evening — courses come first.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: a yakitori and chicken restaurant opened 11 June 2020 on the first floor of Shinpukan, with lunch sets and evening courses and friendly staff (2026 reviews).
